page.title: Builder demonstration: a lesson video
page.standfirst: A test piece for the builder: chapters, step numbers, the scene address and the kit's drawing parts. It is not a lesson's video.
page.summary_html: Two chapters, three scenes. The screens are the training kit's own drawing parts, placed on the stage one part per beat.

brief.purpose: A fixture for the builder, not a piece for viewers.
